query: UPDATE attendance_records SET check_in_latitude = NULL, check_in_longitude = NULL, check_out_latitude = NULL, check_out_longitude = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE org_id = $1 AND business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 AND (check_in_latitude IS NOT NULL OR check_in_longitude IS NOT NULL OR check_out_latitude IS NOT NULL OR check_out_longitude IS NOT NULL)
